_comment: MCP config for clients that read .mcp.json. The somatic apprenticeship server is HTTP (a long-lived pm2 server on :7180, `make somatic-http-up`), so no local secrets land here. The autonomic surface is deliberately not exposed to user-facing clients. Codex reads .codex/config.toml in this checkout (same HTTP url, plus the Neo4j creds for the keeper/launchers).
